records.title: F-Bench: Rethinking Human Preference Evaluation Metrics for Benchmarking Face Generation, Customization, and Restoration
records.reason: FaceQ/F-Bench collects human preference ratings for generated, customized and restored faces; F-Eval is a multimodal evaluator. Evaluation compares 29 face models and image-quality metrics. Its contribution is face-quality measurement, not model inference efficiency; the linked KV-cache lineage does not establish a technical connection.

records.title: LEGOSim: A Unified Parallel Simulation Framework for Multi-chiplet Heterogeneous Integration
records.reason: LEGOSim runs heterogeneous chiplet simulators as parallel simlets, with on-demand synchronization and decoupled communication modeling. Validation against SIMBA and a CiM accelerator reports simulation error below 10%; case studies explore interconnect, buffer, topology and memory design. It is a general architecture simulation framework, not an LLM inference optimization or LLM-specific evaluation; linked NPU/PIM lineage is indirect.

records.title: Incremental Sequence Classification with Temporal Consistency
records.reason: The method incrementally updates sequence classifiers with temporal-consistency constraints and evaluates streaming classification accuracy/consistency under temporal shifts. It concerns task-specific predictive consistency, not autoregressive generation, transformer compression, or inference resource improvements; the linked blockwise decoding title does not create a method-level connection.

records.title: Dato: A Task-Based Programming Model for Dataflow Accelerators
records.reason: Dato presents a task-based programming model/runtime for dataflow accelerators, with programming abstractions and evaluation on accelerator workloads. Its contribution is general programmability and execution of dataflow tasks; no LLM/transformer inference optimization is established in the paper. Link to FPGA spatial LLM inference is an architectural adjacency, but too indirect for a concrete paper followup.

records.title: IDFace: Face Template Protection for Efficient and Secure Identification
records.reason: IDFace protects face templates for secure identification using a privacy-preserving representation and evaluates identification/security utility. It is biometric template security, not language-model quantization or inference; the linked BitNet paper is unrelated to its method.
